# vid2context

> Turn any video into context for AI agents and LLMs: transcripts, metadata, chapters and cited research briefs, as an MCP server, CLI, HTTP API, web app and TypeScript library. Free-first (local models, then free tiers, then keyless hosts, paid APIs last), Apache-2.0.

vid2context takes a video link or a media file and returns its transcript with timestamps, metadata and chapters in a form an agent can read and cite. Sources: YouTube (videos, Shorts, playlists, channels, comments), X (Twitter) posts, podcasts (feeds, Apple Podcasts, Spotify), Bilibili, Vimeo, Loom, Wistia, direct media links, Google Drive, Dropbox and OneDrive share links, local files, videos embedded in web pages, and the 1,000+ sites yt-dlp supports. It uses existing captions first (creator, then platform auto-captions, then a feed's own transcript) and otherwise runs speech-to-text through a free-first chain. Every result lists the providers it tried and why. Raw transcripts are always kept; summaries and briefs are added layers.

Status: version 0.2.0 on npm (`vid2context`, `vid2context-mcp`). The CLI, the MCP server (stdio and remote over HTTPS, 28 tools), the HTTP API with OpenAPI, the web app and the library all work today. A free public instance runs at https://vid2context.com (web app at /app/, API at /api/v1/). Requires Node.js 22 or newer to run locally.

## Install

- No install: https://vid2context.com/app/ (paste a link), or the API: `GET https://vid2context.com/api/v1/context?url=<video link>`
- MCP server, no keys needed: `npx -y vid2context-mcp` (MCP Registry `io.github.nirholas/vid2context`). Claude Code: `claude mcp add --scope user --transport stdio vid2context -- npx -y vid2context-mcp`
- CLI: `npx vid2context <url-or-file> --timestamps`
- [llms-install.md](https://github.com/nirholas/vid2context/blob/main/llms-install.md): step-by-step setup for agents installing the MCP server for a user, with the optional keys and a verification call

- [HTTP API guide](https://github.com/nirholas/vid2context/blob/main/docs/guides/http-api.md)

- [Speech-to-text](https://github.com/nirholas/vid2context/blob/main/docs/guides/speech-to-text.md) and [long audio](https://github.com/nirholas/vid2context/blob/main/docs/long-audio.md): the free-first chain, splitting, stitching and decoder-loop recovery
- [Comparison](https://github.com/nirholas/vid2context/blob/main/docs/comparison.md): how it differs from youtube-transcript-api, YouTube MCP servers, yt-dlp and summarize, and when to use those instead

## Source

- [Core types](https://github.com/nirholas/vid2context/blob/main/packages/core/src/types.ts): VideoRef, VideoMetadata, Transcript, Segment, VideoContext, Tier, Policy, Attempt
- [Provider contracts](https://github.com/nirholas/vid2context/blob/main/packages/core/src/provider.ts): source, captions, stt, llm, embed, video, visual and storage providers; rungs
- [Rung chain](https://github.com/nirholas/vid2context/blob/main/packages/core/src/chain.ts): free-first ordering, cooldowns and fallback
- [Pipeline](https://github.com/nirholas/vid2context/blob/main/packages/core/src/pipeline.ts): getVideoContext, transcribe, chat, expandInput
- [Long audio](https://github.com/nirholas/vid2context/blob/main/packages/core/src/longform/transcribe-long.ts): split, transcribe in parallel, stitch, recover decoder loops
- [Output formats](https://github.com/nirholas/vid2context/blob/main/packages/core/src/format/index.ts): text, json, markdown, srt, vtt, pack, ass, ttml, sbv, lrc, csv

## Providers

- [YouTube](https://github.com/nirholas/vid2context/blob/main/providers/youtube): metadata, chapters, playlists, channels, comments, creator and auto captions through the innertube player API; no key
- [X (Twitter)](https://github.com/nirholas/vid2context/blob/main/providers/x): post metadata, every MP4 quality as a direct link, audio-only HLS for speech-to-text; no key
- [Podcasts](https://github.com/nirholas/vid2context/blob/main/providers/podcast): feeds, Apple Podcasts and Spotify links, Podcasting 2.0 transcripts
- [yt-dlp](https://github.com/nirholas/vid2context/blob/main/providers/ytdlp): the 1,000+ sites yt-dlp supports, downloads and their captions (Node)
- [Speech-to-text](https://github.com/nirholas/vid2context/blob/main/providers/stt-openai-compatible): any OpenAI-compatible /audio/transcriptions API: local servers, Groq, Mistral, OVH (keyless), DeepInfra, Together, OpenAI; also [whisper.cpp](https://github.com/nirholas/vid2context/blob/main/providers/stt-whisper-cpp), [in-browser Whisper](https://github.com/nirholas/vid2context/blob/main/providers/stt-transformers) and [Cloudflare Workers AI](https://github.com/nirholas/vid2context/blob/main/providers/cloudflare-ai)
- [LLM](https://github.com/nirholas/vid2context/blob/main/providers/llm-openai-compatible): any OpenAI-compatible chat API: Ollama, LM Studio, Groq, Cerebras, Mistral, GitHub Models, Gemini, OVH and Pollinations (keyless), OpenAI
